config..claude-plugin/plugin.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json",
  "name": "postman",
  "displayName": "Postman",
  "version": "2.0.1",
  "description": "Work with Postman from your agent: bootstrap a repo's Postman setup, mock an API before it's implemented, run collection and governance checks in CI, monitor a live endpoint, deploy and debug Postman Flows, and publish generated API documentation.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Postman",
    "email": "postman-plugins@postman.com",
    "url": "https://github.com/postmanlabs"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-plugin",
  "repository": "https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-plugin",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "keywords": [
    "postman",
    "api",
    "mocking",
    "monitoring",
    "ci",
    "documentation",
    "ai-readiness",
    "flows"
  ],
  "mcpServers": "./mcp.claude-code.json"
}

markdown_frontmatter.skills/flows/SKILL.md:
name: flows
description: Use when running, deploying, or debugging an existing Postman Flow. Distinguishes local graph execution from a deployed webhook, reuses named input scenarios, and follows a run to the failing block rather than treating an HTTP response as whole-flow success. Use for requests such as "why did this flow fail".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/ci-integration/SKILL.md:
name: ci-integration
description: Use when adding API tests, structural or governance lint, or AI-readiness gates to CI, or publishing reviewed API artifacts to a Postman workspace after merge. Makes contract checks repeatable and separates validation from shared workspace changes. Use for requests such as "run this collection on every PR".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/datasets/SKILL.md:
name: datasets
description: Use when a collection needs queried or joined test inputs, a reusable named view, spreadsheet worksheet data, live database rows, or script access through pm.datasets(). Chooses between a simple iteration file and a dataset while preserving query semantics, portability, and credential boundaries. Use for requests such as "run this collection over database rows".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/performance-testing/SKILL.md:
name: performance-testing
description: Use when load-testing or benchmarking an API with concurrent virtual users and latency or error thresholds. Reuses a collection to probe a chosen failure mode and distinguishes target limits from load-generator limits. Use for requests such as "load test this API".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/api-testing/SKILL.md:
name: api-testing
description: Use when testing an endpoint, running collection assertions, or checking real application traffic against an API contract. Reuses saved requests and reports what live, mocked, or captured-traffic results actually establish. Use for requests such as "test this endpoint".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/api-discovery/SKILL.md:
name: api-discovery
description: Use when finding an API or owner, integrating a public provider, locating Postman resources, or investigating consumers and change impact across services. Turns discovered contracts and mocks into reusable dependencies and identifies evidence outside the current checkout. Use for requests such as "who consumes this endpoint".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/ai-readiness/SKILL.md:
name: ai-readiness
description: Use when assessing or improving how well AI agents can discover, call, and recover from errors with an API. Scores an existing Postman collection or OpenAPI spec and turns measured gaps into contract improvements; supports a separate CI readiness threshold. Use for requests such as "is this API ready for agents".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/api-documentation/SKILL.md:
name: api-documentation
description: Use when defining or improving an API contract, generating documentation from a collection or OpenAPI spec, publishing API docs, or sharing a documentation link. Makes auth, inputs, responses, and examples reusable by callers, tests, and mocks. Use for requests such as "publish API docs".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/variables/SKILL.md:
name: variables
description: Use when parameterizing requests across environments, choosing variable scopes, chaining values in scripts, or referencing credentials without committing or exposing them. Keeps one reusable collection while separating target configuration from secret values. Use for requests such as "where should I put this API key".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/collection-schema-v3/SKILL.md:
name: collection-schema-v3
description: Use when writing or debugging local Postman v3 collection and environment YAML, including collection lint failures. Preserves the per-entity files, inherited context, and schema shapes that make API changes reusable and reviewable in Git. Use for requests such as "fix this request YAML".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/bootstrap/SKILL.md:
name: bootstrap
description: Use when resolving Postman CLI setup, authentication, or a repository workspace binding; initializing local API files; or importing, pulling, pushing, syncing, or sharing workspace resources. Reuses existing context and chooses sync direction without duplicating a workspace or rebinding a dependency. Use for requests such as "set up Postman for this repo".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/postman-mcp-server/SKILL.md:
name: postman-mcp-server
description: Use when working through Postman MCP tools to inspect or change workspace resources, choose a targeted operation, or handle MCP limitations. Supports hosted workflows when the CLI is unavailable and distinguishes tool completion from a usable result. Use for requests such as "use Postman MCP to inspect this collection".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/webhook-testing/SKILL.md:
name: webhook-testing
description: Gives anything that sends webhooks — Stripe, GitHub, Slack, a payment processor, or your own API — a stable public URL that records every request and forwards it to a handler running locally, so you can see exactly what was sent, replay a delivery after a fix instead of re-triggering the sender, and assert on every delivery. Use when the user asks to "test my webhook handler," "get Stripe/GitHub webhooks to localhost," "forward this webhook to my local server," "see what the webhook actually sent," "replay that event," "verify the webhook signature," or "check the webhooks our API sends," whether or not they mention Postman.
markdown_frontmatter.skills/api-mocking/SKILL.md:
name: api-mocking
description: Use when creating a stand-in backend from a collection or OpenAPI spec, testing failure scenarios, or sharing a Code Mock through a workspace and deployed URL. Keeps mock behavior reusable in the repository and distinguishes example replay from stateful behavior. Use for requests such as "mock this backend".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/api-simulation/SKILL.md:
name: api-simulation
description: Use when developing or testing a real service that calls other HTTP APIs. Composes reusable dependency mocks on one local port, verifies which upstream calls the service made, and exercises dependency failures without requiring every service to run. Use for requests such as "run this service with mocked dependencies".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/api-monitoring/SKILL.md:
name: api-monitoring
description: Use when setting up recurring API checks, running or diagnosing a Postman Monitor, changing its schedule, or reaching private APIs through a self-hosted runner. Reuses collection assertions to detect live regressions and traces failures to individual run evidence. Use for requests such as "check this API every minute".
markdown_frontmatter.skills/api-engineer/SKILL.md:
name: api-engineer
description: Use when designing, implementing, mocking, testing, monitoring, documenting, or deploying an API. Guides decisions using reusable local API contracts, tests, and mocks, plus organization-wide dependency context, and routes to the relevant Postman skills. Use for requests such as "implement this endpoint".
